artist: The Shady River Bard & Trevor Swistchew
proposal_notes:
Updated Visual Storyboard (v2) — Incorporating Trevor Swistchew's Notes:
• Kept Simple & Uncluttered: Trimmed to 30 unhurried, breathable 7.5–9s cuts with ZERO streets, buildings, ruins, bridges, or heavy props so the tune carries itself.
• Glens & Hilltop Pipers: Sweeping open Highland glens paired with Lachlan and Hamish standing boldly out in the open ('in flagrante') on bare hilltop crests.
• Subtle Red-Tinted Grass: Gentle, non-graphic camera pans onto natural moorland grass and heather softly tinted with warm red morning/sunset light.
• The Wild Haggis Chase (2:24–2:57): During the lively fiddle-and-pipe reel, two wee shaggy folklore Wild Haggis scamper through the heather with kilted runners in good-humored pursuit!
• Relaxed Sunset Loch Finale (3:05–4:02): Rounds off the entire final chorus and outro on a tranquil, mirror-still Highland loch in warm golden sunset.
visual_style: Simple & Naturalistic Scottish Highlands (Open Glens, Hilltop Pipers, Wild Haggis & Sunset Loch)
